name: Most visited pages

parameters.name: number_of_pages
parameters.description: The number of pages to retrieve

parameters.name: base_url
parameters.description: The Base URL from the report

description: Use the underlying Google Analytics Data to create a list of top 5 pages.
prompt_template:
### Process:

1. Use `get_property_id` to obtain the current Google Analytics property id, then use `lookup_dimension_metric_names` and `run_report` to obtain the top [[number_of_pages]] (default: 5) most visited pages.
2. Create a list of only URLs, by combining the [[base_url]] (default: "<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl>") with the path received from Google Analytics.
3. Output only a list of URLs, nothing else - **DO NOT** output thought process details

### Validation:

The list of pages must not be longer then [[number_of_pages]] if - and only if - [[number_of_pages]] is null or undefined, validate that the list of pages must not be longer then 5 items.

### Good example 1:

###### Inputs:

number_of_pages: `5`

base_url: `https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl`

###### Output:

<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/>\
<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/become-a-customer>\
<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/insights>\
<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/insights/balancing-retirement-and-mortgage-payments-a-guide-for-pre-retirees>\
<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/hysavings>

### Good example 2:

###### Inputs:

number_of_pages: `1`

base_url: `null`

###### Output:

<https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/>

### Good example 3:

###### Inputs:

number_of_pages: `null`

base_url: `https://example.com`

###### Output:

[https://example.com/](https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/)\
<https://example.com/>[become-a-customer](https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/become-a-customer)\
[https://example.com/insights](https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/insights)\
[https://example.com/insights/balancing-retirement-and-mortgage-payments-a-guide-for-pre-retirees](https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/insights/balancing-retirement-and-mortgage-payments-a-guide-for-pre-retirees)\
[https://example.com/hysavings](https://moseybank.epi-demo.nl/hysavings)
